{"code": "import pandas as pd

# We already have the deduplicated, cleaned dataset from earlier
# Now compute response rates within each severity stratum

# Define severity levels in order
severity_order = ['mild', 'moderate', 'severe']

df['severity'] = pd.Categorical(df['severity'], categories=severity_order, ordered=True)

# Compute response rate by arm and severity
crosstab_response = pd.crosstab(df['arm'], df['severity'], values=df['responded'], aggfunc='mean', margins=True)
print("Response rates by arm and severity (proportion responded):")
print(crosstab_response)

# Extract stratum-specific response rates
crosstab_response = crosstab_response.drop(index='All')  # Remove marginal row

# Compute treatment minus control difference in each stratum
stratum_diffs = crosstab_response['treatment'] - crosstab_response['control']
print("\nDifference in proportions (treatment - control) by severity:")
print(stratum_diffs)

# Compute overall proportion of patients in each severity stratum (to use for standardisation)
severity_counts = df['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)
print("\nProportion of patients in each severity stratum:")
print(severity_counts)

# Compute standardised difference (weighted average of stratum-specific differences)
weighted_diff = (stratum_diffs * severity_counts).sum()
print(f"\nStandardised difference in proportions (treatment - control): {weighted_diff:.4f}")"}
